R313.note: Replaces f-string with a ? placeholder and a bound tuple on sqlite3 cursor.execute; query shape and response unchanged.

R314.note: Parameterized %s plus repr() renders CR/LF and other control characters as visible escapes; the added quoting around the username in the log line is stated in the write-up and blocks nothing.

R315.note: Adds secure: true to the res.cookie options; httpOnly and maxAge untouched, no other behaviour changed.

R316.note: Session-bound HMAC synchronizer token checked with hmac.Equal closes the CSRF gap, but the fix silently reorders the checks so an unauthenticated cross-origin request now gets 401 where it got 403, and the existing front end must be changed to fetch and echo X-CSRF-Token before any legitimate update succeeds.

R317.note: Both tainted values pass through $cgi->escapeHTML() in an HTML-body text context; print structure and page output for benign values unchanged.

R318.note: Server-generated GUID name with fixed .cshtml extension removes all client control of the path, but the template is no longer stored under the name the admin gave it (the endpoint's purpose is a later render by template) and the response value changes; this is stated but is an observable change beyond the traversal fix.

R319.note: Single unsigned >= MAX_PLAYERS check against the array's own constant before the write; in-range updates unchanged and the void function had no error path to alter.

R320.note: The ChainUnaryInterceptor shape with Unauthenticated/PermissionDenied codes is right, but the check trusts a client-settable x-user-role metadata entry, so any client reaching :50051 directly bypasses it by sending x-user-role: admin; the write-up flags this as a placeholder, and every legitimate caller now needs the metadata.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode escapes quotes, backslash, angle brackets and U+2028/9 for the JS string-literal context; null coalescing to empty matches the original concatenation output (the built-in HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode would have avoided the new package, but the chosen API is correct).

R322.note: Range check against calibrationTable.size() before operator[], falling back to rawReading exactly as the existing short-message path does; in-range indices unchanged.

R323.note: prepare/bindValue with PDO::PARAM_STR closes the injection, but the original `$stmt === false` guard was dropped without mention, so under a PDO not in exception mode a failed prepare now fatals on a method call on false instead of returning null/404.

R324.note: Separator-qualified HasPrefix containment on the cleaned Join result, placed before both MkdirAll calls and os.Create; legitimate entries extract as before and the symlink gap is stated as out of scope.
